tei:div.tei:p: ༈ zhu yig rin po che gser gyi mchod sdong zhes bya ba bzhugs/

na mo mañdzu shri ye/ shes bya'i mkha' la mkhyen rab dkyil 'khor rgyas/ /mdzad pa'i 'od stong phyogs kyi mthar khyab pas/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa kun nas gsal mdzad pa/ /dpal mgon bla ma'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal//sku tshe snga ma'i skyes rabs dpag tu med pa nas smon lam dang thugs rje'i 'byor ba rlabs che bas/ 'dir yang mkhyen rab dang thugs rje dpag tu med cing*/ bstan pa'i ring lugs gsal bar mdzad pas 'dzam bu'i gling na gdugs zla med pa'i 'dren pa dam par gyur pa/ mi'i dbang po dbang phyug dang ldan pa rnams kyis mnga' dbang bskur zhing*/ lung dang rigs pa dang man ngag gi gnas la dbang 'byor ba'i mdo rgyud man ngag snying po'i don 'dzin pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams kyi thor tshugs g.yo bas zhabs brten gyi padma la reg cing mngon par bstod pas ding sang gi rgyal ba gnyis par gyur pa/ 'dod rgu sbyin pas lha dang mi las 'das pa'i rin po che bla ma chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i drung du/ thos bsam gyi gnas la cung zad sbyangs shing*/ zab mo mchog gi gnas la snying por byed pa/ phyogs med kyi bya bral ba phan pa bzang pos rang gi blo dang 'tshams pa'i don zhu zhing gsol ba/ drung na sku khams bzang zhing 'chad pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ rtsom pa'i gnas la brtson pas bstan pa'i ring lugs rgya cher gsal bar mdzad pa dang*/ khyad par can du bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams kyi rdo rje'i gdan gnyis pa lta bu ni/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po tshangs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par byas pa'i gnas la bsod nams rgya chen po mdzad de/ sngon dang rjes su mthun par snang ngo zhes thams cad mthun par smra ba thos pas dga' spro tshad med pa skyes shing ngo mtshar/ da dung yang thugs rje'i mdzad pa rlabs che bas sngon bzhin bstan pa dang sems can gyi don la dgongs te mdzad par gsol ba 'debs so/

/khyad par du rigs dang 'byor pa rlabs che bas kun gyi bdag por gyur na'ang thams cad sgyu ma'i rnam par gzigs te/ 'jig rten gyi chos las ldog nas dge sbyong gi tshul 'dzin pas bslab pa gsum la gces spras su mdzad cing*/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i bstan pa dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor bas/ snyigs ma'i dus su 'gro ba rnams kyi 'dren pa dam par gyur pa ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /rjes su yi rang ngo*/ / mngon par bstod do/ /drung nas sngar gong du dad pa can gyi rigs su gtogs pa/ 'phan yul ba'i yon btsun 'di pa la gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rnam par bzhag pa gang zhes gsungs zer gin 'dug pas de dang mthun pa'i lan/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab kyi gnas dang mi 'gal bar tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bsnyad de 'bul ba lags so/ /zhu yig gzigs pa'i rten du phyag gcig 'bul/ /rab gsal snyan par smra ba'i ngag 'di ni/ /snyan ngag sdeb sbyor tshul la ma rmongs shing*/ /lung rigs man ngag du ma'i blo mig can/ /snying po'i de nyid rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /gzhung ri rin chen brtsegs pa'i gnas nas phul/ /dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ / gnas skabs bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ /mthar thug nges legs byang chub gnyis thob nas/ /gzhan don mtha' yas chos kyi rgyal por shog /glang lo zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes drug gi nyin/ gzhung ri rin chen gling gi ngogs nas phul ba dge'o// //༈ na mo mañdzu shri ye/ grags dkar bsod nams yon tan phreng tshogs can/ /bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan chen po legs 'dzin pa/ /dpal ldan bzang po'i mtshan gyis brgyan pa la/ /dad brgya'i gtsug gi 'dab stong g.yo bas 'dud/ / gangs can skye rgu yongs kyi bsod nams las/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul ngo mtshar rmad byung gang*/ /dpag med dus nas thugs rje rlabs che bas/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i snyan du tshig 'ga' zhu/

/sa gsum 'byor pa dam pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ / rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen dpag bsam shing*/ /ches cher 'dzin pa'i khur chen legs bsnams pas/ /bsnyel ba mi mnga' ngo mtshar mchog tshogs can/ / phyogs rnams gang na'ang khyed mtshungs yod ma yin/ /mchog gsum 'phags pa'i 'byor pas rab brgyan pas/ /ding sang 'gro kun gtsug gi nor bu la/ / bstan pa'i sgron me mdzad par gsol ba 'debs/ /bdag cag la sogs zhi ba gnyer rnams dang*/ /skye rgu'i tshogs dang thar lam zhugs rnams la/ /phan bde'i rang bzhin thugs rje'i phyag brkyang ste/ /byams pa'i zhal gyi pad mtsho 'dzum par mdzod/ /dam pa khyed kyi gsung zla'i 'od zer ni/ /bdag blo'i ku mud tshal du bstsal ba'i don/ /rgya cher zhu ba'i spobs pa ma mchis kyang*/ /cha tsam mtshon pa'i gzhi lam 'bras bu'i don/ /yid mkha'i lam na cung zad gsal ba rnams/ /tshig don nyer bkra'i gnas la gzigs par gsol/ /gzhi dbyings mi 'gyur sems nyid 'od gsal khams/ /rang bzhin rnam dag bde gshegs snying po la/ /ma rig gzung 'dzin glo bur sgrib pa yis/ /kun tu brtags shing yun ring goms byas pas/ /yul dang don dang sems su bag chags te/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang sna tshogs mngon par grub/ /thog mtha' med can shing rta'i 'phang lo bzhin/ /khams gsum rigs drug bde sdug sna tshogs snang*/ /rang rang las kyis nye bar bkod can no/ /'di kun rang bzhin rmi lam sgyu ma bzhin/ /dri za'i grong dang sprul pa mig yor mtshungs/ /brag ca chu zla 'dra zhing snying po med/ /gsog dang gsob dang ya ma brla 'dra zhing*/ /rkyen snang rten cing 'brel 'byung ngo bo nyid/ /ma brtags nyams dga' brtags na ngos bzung med/ /med pa gsal snang stong pa'i rang gzugs te/ /snang ba'i dus na bden pa'i rang bzhin med/ /med la yod par bzung bas brtags pa tsam/ /gzung ba'i yul med rmi lam sgyu ma'i 'gros/ /gzugs sogs yul lnga rang snang stong gzugs bzhin/

/ngo bo cha shas rang bzhin med pa ste/ /gzhi med gnas med yul dngos grub pa med/ /de phyir gzung dang gzung yul rang bzhin med/ /rnam kun stong par gdod nas dag pa yin/ /'dzin pa'i sems kyang rang bzhin yod min te/ /kun gzhir bsten pa kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang*/ /yid dang nyon yid sgo lnga'i shes pa ste/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems kyi rnam pa yang*/ /rig pa'i cha la ma rig sgro btags kyis/ /kun tu brtags pas sems zhes mtshon pa tsam/ /dpyad na rgyun dang skad cig cha shas med/ /dus gsum mngon med skye 'gag gnas pas stong*/ /gang gis gang 'dzin de la rang bzhin ci/ /kha dog dbyibs med phyogs cha mtha' dbus med/ /bsam dang bral ba nam mkha'i rang bzhin can/ /dngos dang dngos po med pa'i mtshams las 'das/ /ye nas bdag med spros dang bral ba'i phyir/ /'dzin pa'i sems la rang bzhin med pa lags/ /de ltar gzung dang 'dzin pa med pa nyid/ /gdod nas rnam dag don gyi gnas lugs te/ /'khor ba ming tsam sgyu mar rtogs byas nas/ /rten gzhi 'od gsal snying po'i khams la 'jug /'khor 'das kun 'byung rig pa byang chub sems/ /mtha' dang dbus med yangs pa chen po'i klong*/ /stong gsal 'gyur med spros dang bral ba ni/ /nyi mkha' bzhin te rgya chad phyogs lhung med/ /nor bu bzhin te yon tan lhun gyis grub/ /thog mtha' med de dus gsum 'pho 'gyur med/ /'dus ma byas te rgyu rkyen kun las 'das/ / don dam dbyings te zab cing rgya che'i gnas/ /kun la yod kyang rtogs par dka' ba'i don/ /gzhi dbyings mi 'gyur spros dang bral ba lags/ /nam mkha'i ngang du snod bcud snang ba ltar/ /chos rnams thams cad rig pa'i ngang du 'dus/ /mkha' dang snod bcud ngang dang ngang can ltar/ /rigs dang chos kun dbyings dang dbyings snang ste/ /snang dang snang gzhi dpyad na stong pa'i ngang*/ / gcig dang du ma'i cha shas kun las 'das/

/snod bcud chags 'jig 'pho ldog ci byung yang*/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa ltar/ /snang srid 'khor 'das sna tshogs chos rnams kun/ /bde sdug bzang ngan mtho dman ji snyed dang*/ /'khrul snang sbyang phyir gzhi lam 'bras bu'i tshul/ /ma lus dag pa rnam grol mya ngan 'das/ /mdor na 'khor 'das snang ba ci shar yang*/ /rig pa'i ngang la bzang ngan 'pho 'gyur med/ /ye nas lhun grub byang chub sems kyi ngang*/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor chen po nyid/ /tshul 'di don dam nges pa'i snying po ste/ /chos rnams kun gyi gzhi yi gnas lugs lags/ /lam ni dbyings kyi dri ma sel bya ste/ /dbang gzhis smin pa'i rig pa byang chub sems/ / stong nyid snying rje zung du 'brel ba ste/ /zab mo'i gnad kyis nyams su len par 'dod/ /'dir ni rang gi mos dge phun tshogs dang*/ /bla ma'i byin rlabs shin tu rmad byung mthus/ /chos rnams bdag med spros dang bral ba'i don/ /sems nyid 'od gsal gzhi yi gnas lugs nyid/ /dbang khrid gdams pas legs par ngo 'phrod pas/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i lta ba lags par gsungs/ / rtogs pa'i ngang las ma yengs spros dang bral/ /bying rgod mi dmigs bde gsal mi rtog nyams/ /ji ltar skyes kyang de bzhin 'dzin zhen med/ /mkha' ltar rnam dag 'od gsal 'dus ma byas/ /bsam brjod spros dang bral ba'i rig pa nyid/ /rang gsal rang gnas sgom pa'i rgyal po zhes/ /bdag gis legs mthong dpal ldan bla ma'i drin/ /snying po'i de nyid rtogs pa'i ngang gnas lags/ /mchog gsum rdo rje snying po'i khang bzang du/ /mi g.yo ri rgyal lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa/ /gnad gsum chos kyi 'khor lor gnas pa'i tshe/ /rtsa gsum dbu mar dag pa'i rang bzhin du/ /srog rtsol nyi zla'i 'jug pa nub gyur cing*/ / rlung sems mi g.yo shin tu dag pa na/ /bde chen 'od kyis nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par/

/ye shes ro gcig dbyings dang rnam 'dres pas/ /nang gi de nyid 'od gsal shar ba na/ /phyi rol rnam kun stong pa'i 'od gsal gzugs/ / rtags bcu rnam dag med bzhin snang ba ni/ /dag pa'i mkha' la gza' skar bkram pa bzhin/ /de tshe rang bzhin gcig gis gdod ma'i ngang*/ /gar yang mi 'dzin cir yang mi rtog pas/ /gnas lugs rang bzhin shes rab pha rol phyin/ /zung 'jug dbyer med rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*/ /bzhi pa'i de nyid phyag rgya chen po ni/ /mtha' gnyis gnas bsal dbu ma'i rang bzhin te/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gshegs shul lags/ /gang tshe gzung dang 'dzin pa gnyis med par/ /blo yi mdun na 'jug pa zhi gyur pa/ /de tshe bsam brjod spros pa med pa'i dbyings/ /don dam snying po'i de nyid legs bsgoms pas/ /sna tshogs dngos dang de blo mi dmigs par/ /phyi rol snang ba 'od gsal dbyings nub ste/ /nang gi de nyid shin tu mi g.yo ba/ /thog ma dang ni tha ma med pa'i bdag /ma lus dbyings gcig gdod ma'i sar gzhol te/ /rang rig rdo rje'i snying po'i dbyings la 'jug /de nyid goms pas sa lam gong bgrod de/ /spyan dang mngon shes rdzu 'phrul ting 'dzin sogs/ /yon tan sna tshogs gong ma brnyes pa lags/ /mnyam bzhag chos nyid zab mo'i rang bzhin du/ /zag pa med dge spros dang bral ba dang*/ /rjes thob rmi lam sgyu ma'i tshul tsam du/ /sbyin sogs dge ba 'khor gsum dag pas spyod/ /thams cad bden med sgyu mar rnam sbyong ba/ /'di dag lta sgom spyod pa'i rim pa lags/ /mdor na gzhi dbyings rtogs pa lta ba ste/ /dwangs la mi rtog yengs med sgom pa'i mchog /bden med spyod pa rmi lam sgyu ma'i tshul/ /lam gyi chos zhes bla ma sangs rgyas gsungs/ /'di dag mthar phyin 'bras bu'i rim pa ni/ /khams de'i dri ma ma lus dag pa'i tshe/ /sprin bral nyi bzhin dbyings kyi yon tan kun/ /ma lus mngon gyur byang chub chen po ste/

/spangs dang rtogs pa'i yon tan mthar phyin ldan/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa brnyes/ /de tshe dbyings kyi sku gsum ro gcig pas/ /sku gsum mi 'gyur chos sku nyag gcig las/ /ye shes phrin las dag pa'i gzugs sku gnyis/ /rgyal ba'i byin rlabs gdul bya'i smon lam mthus/ /ji ltar 'dod bzhin so sor snang ba ni/ /chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab/ /nor bu ji bzhin 'dod rgu'i re ba skong*/ /srid pa ji bzhin gzhan don rgyun me 'chad/ /'di dag mthar phyin 'bras bu'i rim pa lags/ /de ltar gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rang bzhin dag /cha tsam brjod la nongs pa mchis srid na/ / mkhyen rab dbang phyug dpal mgon bla ma dang*/ /mkhas grub skye bo'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ /slad dus bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam pa khyed/ /sku tshe phrin las kun tu mtha' yas shing*/ /phan bde'i char gyis 'gro la bsil ba dang*/ /bdag kyang dam chos dga' ston 'phel bar shog /tshul 'di blo gros yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /ting 'dzin 'od gsal nyin mor byed pa des/ /zhu yig rab bzang dar dkar gsal ba'i rten/ /grogs ri rin chen brtsegs pa'i gnas nas phul/ /dge ba dpag med rin chen gru bo des/ /ma lus 'gro kun srid mtsho rab brgal nas/ /zhi ba rab bzang thar pa'i gling son te/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'byor pa'i sangs rgyas shog /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par shog /bshes gnyen mchog rnams sku tshe mtha' yas shog /skye rgu dam pa'i chos la gzhol bar shog /rgyal khams kun tu bkra shis bde legs shog /zhu yig rin chen po che gser gyi mchod sdong zhes bya ba/ zhi ba'i nags su zab mo'i de kho na nyid sgrub pa la mngon par brtson pa'i bsam gtan pa kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang pos phul ba/ phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis dang bde legs kyi char bskal pa rdzogs ldan gyi dus su nye bar gnas pa bzhin du bsam rgu'i re ba mtha' dag 'grub cing 'bab par gyur cig
/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (24) zhu yig rin po che gser gyi mchod sdong*/ -PAGE 394--PAGE 401--PAGE 393-
